programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programme.title: Khwahish
programme.desc: Khwahish explores the relationship between a young urban couple from the time they meet during the last semester of college to their budding romance and from the ups and downs of an impending marriage to its tragic end, five years later.

programme.title: Lootere
programme.desc: Two police officers Karan and Ali investigate the murder of their colleague. Karan is put in charge of protecting Anjali, a bar dancer and key witness to the murder. Trouble arises when Karan falls for her which compromises his objectivity.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul is heavily indebted and has to bring up his two notorious nephews and a niece. One day, the kids go to a carnival and befriend a runaway bride. Trouble ensues when they decide to help her by bringing her home and keep her out of Rahul's sight.

programme.title: Dil Ka Rishta
programme.desc: Jai unintentionally kills the husband of a woman that he loves. When she gets diagnosed with amnesia, Jai comforts her and she falls in love with him. Now, guilt-ridden Jai is left in a dilemma whether to confess his guilt or reciprocate her love.
